purpose: Translate observed functions into Hao-original, evidence-gated production capabilities. This is not a request to copy proprietary assets, logos, exact fonts, layouts, timelines or creator identity.

evidence_tiers.A: direct statement from the MrBeast post team or authorised behind-the-scenes material
evidence_tiers.B: frame-by-frame observation of an official MrBeast upload
evidence_tiers.C: production inference; must remain labelled inferred until verified

sources.title: Art of the Cut: Beast Games
MrBeast Breaks Down the VFX Behind Beast Games

pipeline_truth.editorial_first: Clarity precedes stimulation: establish one idea and one emotion, show scale, then escalate and pay off.
pipeline_truth.graphics_vs_vfx: Main-channel overlays are predominantly editable motion graphics and editor-built After Effects composites; set extensions, simulations and photoreal scene alterations are VFX.
pipeline_truth.reusable_unit: Store source rigs, materials, emitters, UI shells and sound families. Do not flatten the system into fixed PNG text or generic icon packs.
pipeline_truth.per_shot_truth: Track data, roto mattes, camera solves, depth/occlusion, lighting match, final text, timing and grade are shot-specific and cannot be pre-generated honestly.

effects.function: Make the premise understandable, reveal scale, escalate, then land one memorable payoff.
qa: payoff is shown long enough to verify

effects.function: Attach a verified price or quantity to the exact subject at the moment it matters.
qa: shadow reads as depth rather than cheap outline

effects.function: Signal an exceptional value with luminous material while keeping the number readable.
qa: core text remains sharper than bloom
green is event emphasis, not default caption colour

effects.function: Locate a moving subject and keep an evidence-backed telemetry value, elbow connector and anchor dot locked to the same track.
per_shot: truth evidence for every measured value
qa: panel, connector and anchor share one verified track

effects.function: Preserve the challenge state and current level without repeated narration.
qa: HUD does not compete with action

effects.function: Start a hero subject fully black, then restore its original colour behind a diagonal specular frontier confined to the subject matte.
reusable: core/bloom material profiles for metal, paint, plastic and glass
per_shot: per-frame subject alpha or polygon matte
effects.fallback: clean hero hold when matte or track is unreliable
qa: first effect frame is black inside the subject matte
diagonal frontier restores the original subject colour
zero black layer or light outside matte
no hand, face or background contamination
never used as a full-frame transition

effects.function: Create a fast motivated edit between two real shots by moving isolated foreground subjects and reconstructed backgrounds at different speeds around one identifiable cut.
effects.fallback: clean cut when either matte, background reconstruction, motion match or edge QA fails
qa: foreground and background have measurable parallax
motion blur is strongest on the background at the cut
chromatic aberration is restrained to the motion peak
no matte halo or black frame

effects.function: Focus attention on one or two people or objects inside a visually crowded scene.
qa: skin and product colours remain plausible

effects.function: Punctuate a verified monetary reveal with foreground, midground and background dollar-note motion.
reusable: generic US-dollar-note particle sprites compliant with reproduction rules
qa: never used to hide a cut
notes have depth and varied motion
does not obscure the value text

effects.function: Move between comparable objects or pull back to expose the true scale of a comparison.
per_shot: real camera move or true 3D camera path
qa: motion covers but does not replace logic

effects.function: Attach a value, ring, bracket or interface to a surface or moving subject with believable perspective.
Create parallax, extruded form, lighting, shadow and material behaviour that cannot be produced honestly by a flat overlay.
qa: matching motion blur and depth of field

effects.function: Integrate a CG object or set extension into moving footage with matched camera, light and occlusion.
effects.fallback: tracked 2D billboard or clean editorial reveal
qa: grain, aberration and lens distortion match

effects.function: Create dust, smoke, crowd or destruction behaviour with physical depth and interaction.
reusable: approved smoke/dust/spark plates for simple overlays
qa: 2D plate is not claimed as a volumetric simulation

effects.function: Make builds, vacuum moments, hits, UI changes and payoffs feel rhythmically intentional.
reusable: licensed whoosh, hit, riser, UI, cash and mechanical families
qa: build then remove air before impact

effects.function: Remove haze, separate the subject and unify live action, graphics and CG without an indiscriminate LUT stack.

capability_definitions.VERIFIED_AUTO: Rendered on real footage, frame-QA passed and Hao approved.
capability_definitions.AUTO_WITH_REVIEW: Automatable only when track/matte evidence passes; human frame review remains mandatory.
capability_definitions.VERIFIED_MANUAL: Well-defined editorial operation that still needs an editor per sequence.
capability_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED: Code or recipe exists but has not yet passed representative render and Hao approval.
capability_definitions.SHOT_SPECIFIC_MANUAL: Cannot be prepared as a finished asset because the shot determines the result.
capability_definitions.EXTERNAL_3D_VFX: Needs Blender/Houdini/After Effects/Nuke-class scene work or an equivalent dedicated pipeline.

global_blockers: no generic icon pack may count as a MrBeast production asset
no flattened raster text may replace an editable type rig
no fake tracking after confidence loss
no full-frame flash may substitute for a subject-masked light sweep
no money particle layer may be treated as a transition
no 2D card may be labelled true 3D
no copied logo, proprietary asset, exact layout or creator identity
no bulk generation before one representative taste and motion test passes Hao review
